definitions.gloss: Sazae-san, comic strip and TV anime
definitions.explanation: A family comic strip by {長谷川町子|はせがわまちこ}, begun in 1946, about the cheerful housewife Sazae and her three-generation household. Its TV anime has aired on Sunday evenings since 1969, making it the longest-running animated TV series in the world.

examples.english: I watch Sazae-san on Sunday evenings.

examples.english: When Sazae-san comes on, I feel gloomy: "Ah, back to work tomorrow."

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- サザエさん⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧: the Sunday-evening blues, named after the show that signals the weekend is over
- サザエさん⟦{一家|いっか}→一家：01723_ikka⟧: Sazae's family, an image of the traditional extended household
- サザエさん⟦じゃんけん→じゃんけん：06520_janken⟧: the rock-paper-scissors game with viewers at the end of each episode

CULTURAL NOTE:
The family members are named after things from the sea: サザエ (turban shell), カツオ (bonito), ワカメ (wakame seaweed).
